headlines.title: 72-year-old hardware store shuts down, chain closes 12 locations
headlines.summary: Kuipers Ace Hardware in Minnesota closes in December as the owner was unable to renegotiate the store’s lease.

headlines.title: Lowe's (LOW) Stock Looks Fairly Valued Despite Its 21% Run
headlines.summary: Lowe's Companies shares have climbed sharply over the past month, which puts fresh attention on a simple question for you as an investor: Is the current price supported by the cash flows this home improvement retailer can realistically produce over time? The stock has gained 20.9% over the past 30 days, so anyone buying today is effectively betting that this quick move lines up with the cash Lowe's can generate in the years ahead.

headlines.title: LOWE'S COMPANIES, INC. DECLARES CASH DIVIDEND
headlines.summary: The board of directors of Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) has declared a quarterly cash dividend of one dollar and 25 cents ($1.25) per share, payable Feb. 3, 2027, to shareholders of record as of Jan. 20, 2027.

headlines.title: Home Depot or Lowe’s: Which Dividend Grower Wins for Long-Term Income?
headlines.summary: Barron's just downgraded Lowe's to Sell, yet the cheaper stock boasts faster dividend hikes and a fatter cushion. With housing stuck in a slump, retirees must decide which payout deserves their trust. The answer splits three ways.

headlines.title: Buy Home Depot or Lowe's Stock Ahead of Much-Anticipated Q3 Results?
headlines.summary: With Home Depot and Lowe's set to report Q3 results next week, here's how the home improvement giants stack up on growth expectations, valuation, and dividends.

description: Lowe's Companies, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a home improvement retailer in the United States and Canada. It provides a line of products for construction, maintenance, repair, remodeling, and decorating. The company also offers home improvement products, such as appliances, seasonal and outdoor living, lumber, lawn and garden, kitchens and bath, hardware, building materials, millwork, paint, rough plumbing, tools, electrical, flooring, and décor. In addition, it provides installation services through independent contractors in various product categories; and extended protection plans and repair services. Further, the company provides design, distribution, and installation services for interior surface finishes to home builders and property managers. It sells its national brand-name merchandise and private brand products to professional customers, individual homeowners, and renters. The company serves its products through Lowes.com website, mobile applications, retail home improvement stores and outlet stores, and its branches. Lowe's Companies, Inc. was founded in 1921 and is based in Mooresville, North Carolina.
